en.pageTitle: Hengmu — Evidence-bound architecture review for Codex and Agent Plugins
en.pageDescription: Hengmu is an evidence-bound architecture review and target-design tool for Codex and compatible Agent Plugins, with verification, decisions, remediation plans, and deterministic quality gates.
en.socialImageAlt: Hengmu — evidence-bound architecture design and decisions, a Qingye open-source project
en.heroTitle: Turn repository truth into architecture decisions that survive scrutiny.
en.heroBody: Hengmu turns facts, approved design intent, and explicit constraints into evidence-bound architecture reviews, open or constrained targets, decisions, implementation plans, and deterministic gates for Codex and compatible Agent Plugins.
en.heroNote: Codex package + portable Agent Plugins · Python 3.11–3.14 · No hosted runtime
en.heroAlt: The Qingye builder calibrates repository facts and required, preferred, and prohibited constraints into a target architecture
en.decisionTitle: Start with an assessment or a design brief. End with a governed decision.
en.decisionAria: Hengmu architecture decision paths from project context to deterministic gate
en.capabilitiesTitle: Assess the present. Design the target. Govern the change.
en.capabilityAssessmentBody: Boundaries, quality attributes, candidate findings, verification
en.capabilitySolutionsBody: Open or constrained units, data, interfaces, trust, operations
en.scaleTitle: One method. Every project keeps its own truth.
en.scaleAlt: One shared method spans different projects while the Qingye builder adjusts for project profiles and real constraints and exposes hidden coupling
en.repositoryBody: Profile · constraints · critical flows · review history
en.portfolioBody: Shared capabilities · data flow · ownership · hidden coupling
en.trustTitle: Models propose. Evidence and policy decide what becomes trusted.
en.trustBody: A passing gate proves policy evaluation of supplied artifacts — not that a system is automatically correct, secure, or well designed.
en.skillsTitle: One entry. Eight focused architecture workflows.
en.startTitle: Start with repository truth or an approved brief.
en.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the command and copy it manually.

zh-CN.pageTitle: 衡木 — 面向 Codex 与 Agent Plugins 的受证据约束架构审查
zh-CN.pageDescription: 衡木是面向 Codex 和兼容 Agent Plugins 的受证据约束架构审查与目标设计工具，提供核实、决策、改造计划和确定性质量门禁。
zh-CN.socialImageAlt: 衡木——受证据约束的架构设计与决策系统；青野开源项目
zh-CN.heroTitle: 让仓库真实上下文，形成经得起复核的架构决策。
zh-CN.heroBody: 衡木把事实、已批准设计意图和明确约束转化为受证据约束的架构审查、开放式或受约束目标、决策、实施计划和确定性门禁，面向 Codex 与兼容 Agent Plugins。
zh-CN.heroNote: Codex 压缩包 + 可移植 Agent Plugins · Python 3.11–3.14 · 无托管运行时
zh-CN.heroAlt: 青野角色校准仓库事实与必需、偏好、禁止约束，并搭出目标架构
zh-CN.decisionTitle: 从现状审查或设计 Brief 开始，以受治理的决策结束。
zh-CN.decisionAria: 衡木从项目上下文到确定性门禁的架构决策路径
zh-CN.capabilitiesTitle: 审查现状。设计目标。治理变更。
zh-CN.capabilityAssessmentBody: 边界、质量属性、候选问题、独立核实
zh-CN.capabilitySolutionsBody: 开放式或受约束单元、数据、接口、信任、运维
zh-CN.capabilitySpecializedBody: 选项、取舍、授权、实施切片
zh-CN.capabilityGovernanceBody: 证据、来源、权限、确定性门禁
zh-CN.scaleTitle: 一套方法。每个项目保留自己的真实上下文。
zh-CN.scaleAlt: 一套共享方法横跨不同项目，青野角色依据项目画像和真实约束调整支点并发现隐性耦合
zh-CN.repositoryBody: 项目画像 · 约束 · 关键链路 · 审核历史
zh-CN.portfolioBody: 共享能力 · 数据流 · 所有权 · 隐性耦合
zh-CN.trustTitle: 模型可以提出建议。证据和策略决定什么能够成为可信结论。
zh-CN.trustBody: 门禁通过只证明已提供产物满足策略，不证明系统自动正确、安全或设计优秀。
